name: Cefepime
drafted_by: AI-assisted draft (Claude) for review by Dr. W. Rivero

usual_adult_dose.dose: 1 to 2 g IV every 8 to 12 hours (P. aeruginosa: 2 g every 8 hours)

usual_adult_dose.indication: Mild to moderate urinary tract infection
usual_adult_dose.dose: 0.5 to 1 g IV or IM every 12 hours
See kidney table: same first dose, then reduced maintenance by CrCl

key_interactions.effect: Nephrotoxicity reported with cephalosporins given with these drugs (label).

common: Low phosphorus; raised ALT, AST, PT and PTT
serious: Neurotoxicity: encephalopathy, myoclonus, seizures, nonconvulsive status epilepticus (mainly unadjusted doses in kidney impairment)

contraindications: Immediate hypersensitivity to cefepime, cephalosporins, penicillins or other beta-lactams
monitoring: Mental status and neurologic signs, especially in kidney impairment
Kidney function with aminoglycosides or loop diuretics

pk.half_life_eskd: 13.5 hours on hemodialysis; 19 hours on continuous peritoneal dialysis (label)
pk.excretion_renal_pct: Mainly renal; clearance falls in proportion to CrCl (label)

sources.citation: Sagent Pharmaceuticals. (2026). Cefepime for injection, USP [Prescribing information; US FDA-approved label, ANDA065441, set ID de477f37-40f6-4295-ae72-a2ee36a8922e, version effective August 3, 2026]. DailyMed, U.S. National Library of Medicine.
